installation_steps.desc: Update package index and install prerequisites
installation_steps.cmd: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl

installation_steps.desc: Ensure proper permissions for the GPG key
Add the Docker repository to Apt sources
installation_steps.cmd: echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo "$VERSION_CODENAME") stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null

installation_steps.desc: Update package index with new repository
Install Docker Engine and Compose plugins
installation_steps.cmd: sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
